subject: Onboarding: remit schedule, PO flow and early-pay option from Sierra Supply
messages:
From: Tara Nguyen <tara.nguyen@sierrasupply.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & Remit: onboarding questions + early-pay option

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intake — excited to get Sierra Supply set up as a preferred hardware vendor for Redwood. A couple of items from our side so Procurement can proceed: 

- Standard commercial terms we typically request: Net 45 (invoice date) but we can offer a 2% discount if payment is made within 10 days of invoice.
- We need to understand your PO issuance cadence (do you issue POs before fulfillment or after first delivery?) and whether PO numbers are required for every invoice.
- Attached is our vendor profile (sierra_vendor_profile.pdf). I can also send a W-9 and a sample invoice on request.

If it helps, we can sign any required onboarding/PO acknowledgement electronically — happy to complete a DocuSign.

Proposed next step: quick sync or confirm in email what documentation Procurement needs and whether Finance would consider the early-pay discount program.

Thanks,
Tara Nguyen
Accounts Manager | Sierra Supply
accounts@sierrasupply.com
Attachment: sierra_vendor_profile.pdf

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Tara Nguyen <tara.nguyen@sierrasupply.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & Remit: onboarding questions + early-pay option

Hi Tara — thanks, and welcome.

Quick answers and requests so we can move procurement forward:

- PO process: Procurement issues a PO prior to first invoice for new vendors in the supplier class; PO numbers are required on all invoices to route to AP.
- Terms: our default is Net 60 for hardware suppliers, but Finance is open to evaluating early-pay discounts for predictable suppliers.

Could you send: a completed W-9, a redlined vendor agreement if you have one, and a sample invoice (PDF) that shows the invoice date and banking details? Also please indicate if the 2% early-pay is applied to invoice subtotal or total after tax/shipping.

Looping in Marissa from Procurement and Marcus in Finance to coordinate PO issuance and accelerated-pay enrollment.

Thanks — I can also set a 20-min call if you'd prefer to walk through the onboarding steps.

Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 06 Sep 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & Remit: onboarding questions + early-pay option

Hi Tara — welcome. A few procurement items to make the PO flow smooth: 

1) Required documents before PO issuance: signed vendor onboarding form (attached: vendor_onboard_form.xlsx), W-9, and supplier bank details (either on signed form or on first invoice).
2) PO timing: For new vendors, we create an initial PO that covers the first shipment milestone; subsequent POs are created monthly for recurring services or per-delivery for hardware shipments.
3) Terms: Our standard master purchase order comes with Net 60. We can request a one-off Net 30 during an initial trial program, but that needs Finance sign-off.
4) PO placement: Please include the Redwood PO number on the invoice PDF in the top-right; missing PO numbers delay payment.

I attached the onboarding spreadsheet that has the fields we need filled — if you return it completed we can queue the vendor for PO creation. If you prefer, I can send a DocuSign for the onboarding form.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: vendor_onboard_form.xlsx

Thanks for looping me in. A few Finance notes: 

- We can evaluate a 2% early-pay discount program, but enrollment requires the vendor to join our accelerated-pay vendor portal and accept the program terms. Early-pay discounts are calculated on the invoice net amount (before tax and shipping) unless otherwise specified in a written agreement.
- "Invoice receipt" vs "invoice date": we use invoice receipt (date AP receives a clean invoice with PO and required docs) for early-pay calculations — please confirm your team can get invoices to accounts@redwood.com and include the PO number on the first page.
- For initial onboarding, Finance will provisionally approve a Net 30 payment milestone for the first 90 days (to reduce onboarding friction). After the 90-day review we will move to the vendor class default (Net 60) unless we have a recurring high-volume cadence.

Action items for Sierra Supply to enable accelerated-pay evaluation:
- Return completed onboarding form + W-9 (signed PDF)
- Provide sample invoice and bank remittance instructions
- Fill out the DocuSign enrollment envelope (I will send the link after Marissa confirms form reception)

Marissa — if you confirm receipt of the form, I'll generate the enrollment link (DocuSign) and flag this as "accelerated-pay candidate" in AP.

Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

If Finance is able to provisionally set Net 30 for the first 90 days, that would speed up delivery on our side. Looking forward to the PO.
